item.title: Messi and Brady on 'prophetic' Lamine Yamal photos
item.description:
A Fateful Encounter: Messi and Brady Ponder the Prophetic Photos

Lionel Messi and Tom Brady are two of the most accomplished athletes of their respective generations, and yet, their paths converged in a moment that has been described as “very prophetic” by the NFL legend. The two sports icons gathered in New York, mere days before the World Cup final, to discuss a photograph that has taken on a life of its own – a snap from 2007 that captured Messi holding five-month-old Lamine Yamal, the current Spain captain.
